query: What happened at the Academy Awards involving Will Smith and Chris Rock?
answer:
During the 94th Academy Awards on March 27, 2022, Chris Rock appeared onstage to present the award for Best Documentary Feature. During his introduction, Rock made a joke referencing Jada Pinkett Smith's shaved head, saying: "Jada, I love you. G.I. Jane 2, can’t wait to see it, all right?" 

In response, Will Smith walked onto the stage and slapped Rock across the face. After returning to his seat, Smith repeatedly shouted at Rock to "Keep my wife’s name out your fucking mouth." Rock briefly reacted to the confrontation, noting to the audience, "Will Smith just smacked the shit out of me," before finishing the presentation of the award. 

Later that evening, Smith won the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role in *King Richard*. Following the incident, Smith apologized, resigned from the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences on April 1, and on April 8, the Academy barred him from attending any Academy events or programs, including the Oscars, for 10 years.
